text.p: Sandra Voelker of Germany swam the fastest 50 metres backstroke of the year in a European record time of 29.00 seconds in the heats of the Monaco International Meeting on Saturday.

The Olympic bronze medal winner led her heat from the start against China's Chan Yan and Russian Olga Kochekova to beat the previous European best of 29.12 held since September 1988 by Kristin Otto of the then East Germany.
The performance came as some comfort to the organisers after Russia's Denis Pankratov pulled out of the men's 50 backstroke at the last minute.

Organisers had already been dismayed by the decision of other top international swimmers, Russian Alexander Popov, Costa Rica's Claudia Poll and American Gary Hall not to take part in this first of three successive meetings which also include Barcelona and Le Canet in France.

Double Olympic champion Pankratov, who is in the principality with the Russian team, is believed to be reserving himself for an attempt on his long-course 200 metres butterfly world record at Le Canet.
The team's official reason for his withdrawal was "the Russian champion has an ailment."
